# Walk In Tubs Texas

> WalkInTubsTexas.com is the statewide Texas guide to walk-in tubs, transfer tubs and accessible showers from Aging Safely Baths (https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/), which has served customers since 2012. Phone 1-888-779-2284. Quotes are written per home; no prices are published. Houston-area homes are covered by the sister site https://walkintubshouston.com/.

## Key facts

- Provider: Aging Safely Baths, an Ella's Bubbles dealer. Brands: Ella's Bubbles, Hydro Dimensions, Bestbath (incl. RANE by Bestbath), Meditub.
- Coverage: supply-only shipping throughout Texas with phone tech support; coordinated installation depends on area (call to confirm).
- Medicare: Original Medicare generally does not cover walk-in tubs (medicare.gov DME rules).
- Quote form: EmailJS; phone 1-888-779-2284.
